Easy Peasy BBQ Sauce
By: Natalya
Published: Tuesday, June 28, 2011 - 4:29pm

Ingredients




1 cp Tomato Sauce
1/2 cp Ketchup
1 Yellow onion
S& P
1/4 cp Worcestershire Sauce
1/2 cp Packed light brown sugar
1 teaspoon Chili powder
1 tablespoon Garlic& Herb seasoning (to carry the flavor out from the rib
1 teaspoon EVOO
1 tablespoon Apple cider vinegar

Preparation

1 Add EVOO to hot pot, add diced yellow onion and allow to sweat for about 3mins. 2 Add all other ingredients and allow to simmer on low heat for about 10-15mins. 3 DeliciouslySuite.wordpress.com
